requirements.quote:
CLASS fields appear in resource records.  The following CLASS mnemonics
and values are defined:
requirements.required_behavior: Include a CLASS field in the resource record.
requirements.why_checkable: The resource-record format can be inspected for the presence of a CLASS field.

requirements.quote:
CLASS fields appear in resource records.  The following CLASS mnemonics
and values are defined:

IN              1 the Internet
requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the Internet CLASS (IN) in a resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Map the Internet CLASS mnemonic IN to numeric CLASS value 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The IN mnemonic and numeric CLASS mapping can be checked in record parsing and encoding.

requirements.quote:
CLASS fields appear in resource records.  The following CLASS mnemonics
and values are defined:

IN              1 the Internet

CS              2 the CSNET class (Obsolete - used only for examples in
                some obsolete RFCs)
requirements.condition: If representing the obsolete CSNET CLASS (CS), described as used only for examples in obsolete RFCs.
requirements.required_behavior: Map the obsolete CSNET CLASS mnemonic CS to numeric CLASS value 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The optional representation of the obsolete class can be inspected for the CS-to-2 mapping; this does not require active support for CSNET.

requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the CHAOS CLASS (CH) in a resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Map the CHAOS CLASS mnemonic CH to numeric CLASS value 3.
requirements.why_checkable: The CH mnemonic and numeric CLASS mapping can be checked in record parsing and encoding.

requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the Hesiod CLASS (HS) in a resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Map the Hesiod CLASS mnemonic HS to numeric CLASS value 4.
requirements.why_checkable: The HS mnemonic and numeric CLASS mapping can be checked in record parsing and encoding.
